detached: You are not on a branch (HEAD is detached). Switch to a branch first.
noRemoteToFetch: This repository has no remote to fetch from.
noPullRefs: {remote} offers no pull requests as refs. GitHub, GitLab and Gitea do; other hosts may not.
pullUntrusted: Pulling checks files out and can run this repository's hooks and filters, so it runs only in a trusted folder. Fetch works here; trust this folder to pull.
noUpstream: {branch} tracks no remote branch, so there is nothing to pull. Push it first to set one up.
submodulesUntrusted: Updating submodules clones from the addresses in this repository's .gitmodules and checks files out, so it runs only in a trusted folder. Trust this folder to update them.
noRemoteToPush: This repository has no remote to push to.
pushUntrusted: Pushing runs this repository's pre-push hook, so it runs only in a trusted folder. Trust this folder to push.
stale: {remote}/{target} has changed since this repository last fetched it, so it was not overwritten. Fetch and look at what is there first.
tagThere: {remote} already has a tag {name} on another commit; it was left as it is.
